zh: 正在为<color=#FFC600> {action} </color>重新绑定，当前按键：<color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\n请按任意键设置新按键\n提示：如果 {key} 已被其他操作使用，此次更改将不会应用
en: Rebinding <color=#FFC600> {action} </color> Current key: <color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\nPress any key to assign a new binding.\nNote: if {key} is already assigned to another action, this change will not be applied.
